parsed.explanation: Restored Mac-Roman misreadings of UTF-8 (√º→ü, √§→ä, √ü→ß, √†→à) and garbled umlauts in Bücher and Leuchter. Corrected OCR non-words: Ccena→Coena, Eremplar→Exemplar, Carechetischer→Catechetischer, Kupffer-Btatt→Kupffer-Blatt, and added the missing period after Christ. XML: closed the last price with </PRIZE> not </PRICE>; moved à and full amounts into PRIZE (including achthalben bz.); retagged the sheet-count, which is not a price, as EXTENT; removed the erroneous FORMAT wrapper around 9. 1.; normalized the missing period and space between PLACE and YEAR in entry 3. Historical spellings (Buchtruckerey, Gebatt, Pfalms, Kinderen, etc.) were left unchanged.
